# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`; a job that instead runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux is the deliberate exception, as upstream's blocking `windows` job did. This fork's `ci.yml` currently defines no Windows job at all — `windows`, `windows-native`, `wine-apt-cache`, and the `serial-windows` standby were dropped because none of their target runner pools exist on this fork; see the [fork CI trim](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-16-fork-ci-trim.md) Agent Note, which also covers the [failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md) and [native-Windows pull-request CI](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-08-native-windows-pull-request-ci.md) notes this diverged from.
